findings.decompiled: _1 = stor[5] / owner = 0 / log OwnershipTransferred(address indexed previousOwner=address(_1), ...)
findings.source: OpenZeppelin Ownable._transferOwnership: address oldOwner = _owner; _owner = newOwner; emit OwnershipTransferred(oldOwner, newOwner);
findings.issue: The read of the old owner prints as stor[5] (whole slot) although def storage names slot 5 owner and every use is address(_1).
findings.rule: When every use of a full-slot read is masked to a named field, print the field name (_1 = owner).

notes: OpenZeppelin v5 ERC20 + Ownable, no loops. All 15 functions match by reading: custom errors with their arguments (OwnableUnauthorizedAccount, ERC20InvalidSender/Receiver/Approver/Spender, ERC20InsufficientBalance/Allowance), _spendAllowance's infinite-allowance test printed as '< 2**256 - 1' (equivalent to '!='), the unchecked balance/supply updates and the checked totalSupply increment in mint, the storage-string getters with the Panic(34) encoding check.
summary: Clean, faithful text for a simple loop-free ERC20; only the old-owner read is printed as stor[5].
